instantiated_cells.justification: Section 13.64(1) requires every principal who makes expenditures or incurs obligations exceeding $500 in a calendar year for lobbying to register, and §13.621(5) creates the verified-statement exemption for principals not exceeding $500.

Section 13.68(1)(a)6. requires that if total lobbying expenditures/obligations to any lobbyist exceed $200 during the reporting period, the name, address, and total amount must be itemized on the expense statement.

Section 13.621(5) exempts principals from licensing, registration, and §13.68 reporting requirements if they anticipate making lobbying expenditures or incurring obligations not exceeding $500 in a calendar year and file a verified statement.

Section 13.68(1)(a) and (1)(c) exclude from the aggregate expenditure reporting and time itemization the lobbying expenditures and time of any non-lobbyist employee who devotes not more than 10 hours to lobbying during a reporting period.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: Wisconsin's lobbyist definition in §13.62(11) does not impose a dollar compensation threshold on the individual lobbyist; it requires only that the individual receive "economic consideration, other than reimbursement for actual expenses" without specifying a dollar amount.

input.justification: Section 13.64(1) requires every principal who makes expenditures or incurs obligations exceeding $500 in a calendar year for lobbying to register, and §13.621(5) creates the verified-statement exemption for principals not exceeding $500.

Section 13.62(11) states that if an individual's duties are not limited exclusively to lobbying, the individual is a lobbyist only if he or she makes lobbying communications on each of at least 5 days within a reporting period.

Section 13.68(1)(a)6. requires that if total lobbying expenditures/obligations to any lobbyist exceed $200 during the reporting period, the name, address, and total amount must be itemized on the expense statement.

Section 13.621(5) exempts principals from licensing, registration, and §13.68 reporting requirements if they anticipate making lobbying expenditures or incurring obligations not exceeding $500 in a calendar year and file a verified statement.

Section 13.68(1)(a) and (1)(c) exclude from the aggregate expenditure reporting and time itemization the lobbying expenditures and time of any non-lobbyist employee who devotes not more than 10 hours to lobbying during a reporting period.
